### Environment
```{r setup}

  echo = TRUE,

# Environment Set up
rm(list = ls()) #Clean workspace
cat("\014")     #Clean Console
gc() # Free memory

# pipeline variables
long.compute <- FALSE

# Establish working directory
library("rstudioapi")

# Set working directory to source file location
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
setwd(here::here())   # project root; works in RStudio, knitr and Rscript

# Create output directories & load custom functions & colour scheme

# need to downgrade to 3.4.4 for nebulosa

```


### load dataset
```{r load_dataset}

#######################
# load dataset
#######################

# dataset processed as part of Tabula_Sapiens github repo, filter and normalise and integrate and caclulate umap dims etc all done in that script

ts.immune.seurat <- LoadH5Seurat("saves/TS_immune_imputed.h5Seurat", assays = c("SCT", "alra"))

################################################################################################
# for easy of use rename the integrattted cca umap in the object to just "umap"
################################################################################################

new_reduction <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = Embeddings(ts.immune.seurat, reduction = "umap.cca.sct"), key = "umap")
ts.immune.seurat[["umap"]] <- new_reduction

```

## Visualise {.tabset}



### Broad overview of dataset
```{r dataset_overview}


output.dir <- "results/data_overview/"
if(!dir.exists(output.dir)){
  dir.create(output.dir, 
             recursive = T)}



library(ggplot2)


head(ts.immune.seurat@meta.data)
rownames(ts.immune.seurat)


if(do.plot){
  
  vars.plot <- c("donor", "organ_tissue", "gender", "anatomical_information", "Grouped_l1", "Grouped_l2", "Grouped_l3", "Grouped_l4", "seurat_clusters")
  
  for(i in seq_along(vars.plot)){
    
    print(scCustomize::DimPlot_scCustom(ts.immune.seurat, 
                                        reduction = "umap.cca.sct", 
                                        group.by = vars.plot[i], 
                                        pt.size = 1,
                                        label = TRUE,
                                        figure_plot = TRUE)
    )
    
    
    dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "UMAP_integrated_tabula_sapiens_dataset_grouped_by_", vars.plot[i], ".pdf"))
    dev.off()
    
  }
}


# Gene lists come from a separate, unpublished ILC analysis (not included).
# Supply your own celltype_DEGs_sc.csv here to run this section.
input.dir <- "data/external/gene_lists/"


# save to file 
DEGs.de.sc <- read.csv(paste0(input.dir, "celltype_DEGs_sc.csv"))

# NLC signature
goi <- DEGs.de.sc %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster == "NLC") %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

NLC.sig <- goi


#NLC.sig.hs <- usefulfunctions::convert.mouse.to.human(NLC.sig, use.jax = T)

NLC.sig <- toupper(NLC.sig)


ts.immune.seurat <- AddModuleScore(ts.immune.seurat, features = list(NLCsig = NLC.sig), search = T, name = "NLCsig")


ts.immune.seurat@meta.data
VlnPlot_scCustom(ts.immune.seurat, features = "NLCsig1", group.by = "Grouped_l4", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()

head(ts.immune.seurat@meta.data)

```
